history.value: On decks holding cards it never trained on, the one-turn net keeps about half of its end-HP edge over the heuristic and none of its clears edge. Cell gauntlet by half, paired against the heuristic on the same sequences: the 10-29 net on train sequences +3.27 (0.83) HP and +0.080 (0.025) clears (0-499), +4.11 (0.87) and +0.100 (0.026) (500-999); on held-out sequences +1.82 (1.05) and -0.004 (0.024), +2.36 (1.03) and +0.008 (0.022); its seed twins s101 and s201 the same (train +2.71, +2.96 HP and +0.072, +0.056 clears; held-out +1.23, +1.41 and +0.004, -0.008). On the headline setting with own picks the net's lead over the heuristic is +0.200 (0.038) clears on train sequences and +0.092 (0.036) on held-out ones. The heuristic plays every card by its rules, so this is a zero-shot cost against a player that is not new to the cards. The effects encoding carries part of the way: at 5k games ids minus effects is -4.1 HP on the held-out half and -0.8 on the train half (three seed pairs), and that gap is structural (an id net sees an unseen card as unknown). The two-turn gain over one turn is the same on both halves of the headline (+0.144, +0.164 clears). Planning rules: the cards rung's zero-shot number is the train edge minus the held-out edge on existing nets; unseen official cards are new content a burst can train on (the adapted column, and a product net trained on every official card). Exits: a burst on held-out cards that does not raise the held-out half on three seeds; a difficulty-matched read showing the gap comes from the held-out decks being easier (the heuristic clears 0.68-0.75 there against 0.51).

history.value: The zero-shot cost of unseen cards one turn deep is the cost of one card, Demon Form (3 energy, 2 Strength at each turn start), and on generated cards of the powers whose payoff first comes at the owner's turn start; the key's name is historical. Cell gauntlet, both books, paired edge over the heuristic in end-HP on train decks / held-out decks without Demon Form (326 sequences) / held-out decks with it (174), se over sequences: effects 5k +0.56 / +1.74 (0.67) / -7.23 (1.19); 20k +2.74 / +3.64 / -6.41 (1.24); 40k +3.74 / +4.30 / -3.08 (1.24); product recipe (three seeds) +3.44 (0.55) / +5.28 (0.74) / -4.26 (1.32), clears +0.08 / +0.08 / -0.12 (0.03); ids 5k -0.68 / -1.28 (0.72) / -12.40 (1.28), and -4.35 (1.38) on Metallicize decks without Demon Form. By card (end-HP regressed on the copies of each of 31 cards): a copy of Demon Form is worth +2.4 (1.4) HP to the heuristic and -5.2 (1.4) to the one-turn product nets; no other card differs by more than 2.4. The nine other unseen cards cost nothing, by effects or by id: the search plays the card in the engine and the net reads the state after it. The by-half gap (measurement/cards-by-half@cells, about 2 HP at every training size) is this card averaged over the half. Two turns deep the cost is mostly gone: the 10-29 net gains +8.38 (1.83) HP and +0.22 (0.04) clears over one turn on Demon Form decks against +2.2 to +2.5 HP elsewhere (sequences 0-249 and 500-749), leaving 3.5 (1.9) HP against the heuristic on that net and nothing on a second (burst8hp2, 750 sequences). Generated-power bench (elite and boss fights, three copies of a power, 10-29 net minus heuristic, wins, one turn deep): original Demon Form decks -0.140 (0.024); generated powers triggering at the owner's turn start -0.292 (0.044), at turn end -0.061 (0.034), on a card played +0.005 (0.030), on HP lost -0.02 to +0.13. On the headline the net's chooser takes Demon Form 0.19-0.25 of the times it is offered (the heuristic's 0.68), and where the one-turn net took it it clears 0.405 and 0.480 against 0.70-0.84 elsewhere (the product 0.821 and 0.714 against 0.86-0.89). Why: the heuristic prices a recurring power by rule (hook_rates); one turn deep the payoff never fires inside the search, so the net must have learned the power's worth (the shape of cause/novelty-is-horizon on the player's side). Planning rules: a card or modifier whose effect lands inside the turn has no zero-shot cost to measure; the cards rung spends its fights on powers that pay over later turns; a one-turn read on held-out sequences reports Demon Form decks (or the sequences where it was taken) apart; games-to-learn a recurring power is the rung's adapted column (lane/yardstick-cards step 2). The numbers are the navigator's inline read of existing files; step 1b rebuilds them as measurement/cards-by-card@cells. Exits: step 1b's script disagreeing with these numbers; bursts that raise the Demon Form decks on no game source over three seeds (then games at these sizes do not teach a recurring power).

The turn-start leaf (@tsl1, measurement/turn-start-leaf@cells) repairs it with no games: the 10-29 net minus the heuristic on held-out Demon Form decks goes from -4.12 (1.41) HP and -0.144 clears to +3.43 (1.13) and +0.006, beside +3.67 on train decks and +5.45 on the other held-out decks (both cell books, se over sequences); generated OwnerTurnStart powers +0.243 (0.054) wins. Learned repairs of the same cost, plain leaf: effects nets at 5k to 40k games close Demon Form decks from -7.2 to -3.1 HP against the heuristic; burst8 (eight generated power cards, three holding Demon Form's own row) +6.10 (1.16) over the 10-29 net at -0.9 to -1.1 HP elsewhere (measurement/cards-transfer@cells); two turns of search +8.4 HP. On the headline the net's chooser takes Demon Form 0.19-0.25 of the times offered (the heuristic's 0.68), its trial fights being one turn deep. Planning rules: a card whose effect lands inside the turn, or whose turn-start tick needs no chance, has no zero-shot cost one turn deep with @tsl1; goal-1 card reads play @tsl1 with the plain leaf beside it on turn-start parents (decision/turn-start-leaf-reads); what is left to measure on cards is how the net prices a power's later ticks and content built from atoms it cannot read (how/burst-inputs). Exits: a turn-start hook needing chance (a draw, a random target) costing more than 0.1 wins with @tsl1 on; burst8 ahead of the 10-29 net under @tsl1 on Demon Form decks by 2 se (jobs 0327-0332; then nets learn more than the tick).

Of ten unseen official cards only Demon Form cost (a copy -7.54 (1.23) HP nets minus heuristic, measurement/cards-by-card@cells), and on generated cards the powers paying at the owner's turn start (-0.292 (0.049) wins against the heuristic): the plain one-turn leaf is the state at the next turn's draw, before turn-start hooks run, so such a power's first tick never landed inside the search. The turn-start leaf (@tsl1, measurement/turn-start-leaf@cells) repairs it with no games: the 10-29 net minus the heuristic on held-out Demon Form decks goes from -4.12 (1.41) HP and -0.144 clears to +3.43 (1.13) and +0.006, beside +3.67 on train decks and +5.45 on the other held-out decks (both cell books, se over sequences); generated OwnerTurnStart powers +0.243 (0.054) wins. The nine other unseen cards cost the 10-29 net (effects inputs) nothing against the heuristic: the search plays them in the engine and the net reads the state after; an id-only net does pay there (effects minus ids +3.02 (0.54) HP on held-out decks without Demon Form, +5.16 (0.85) on Demon Form decks, +1.23 (0.64) on train decks, over five 5k twins one turn deep; big-picture-2026-11-09, claim 3, a skeptic's recompute from results/gauntlet/rerank-*data5k* and *ids5k*), so the encoding carries transfer to unseen cards. Learned repairs of the same cost, plain leaf: effects nets at 5k to 40k games close Demon Form decks from -7.2 to -3.1 HP against the heuristic; burst8 (eight generated power cards, three holding Demon Form's own row) +6.10 (1.16) over the 10-29 net at -0.9 to -1.1 HP elsewhere (measurement/cards-transfer@cells); two turns of search +8.4 HP. On the headline the net's chooser takes Demon Form 0.19-0.25 of the times offered (the heuristic's 0.68), its trial fights being one turn deep. Planning rules: a card whose effect lands inside the turn as damage dealt, HP kept or cards played, or whose turn-start tick needs no chance, has no zero-shot cost one turn deep with @tsl1, atoms the net cannot read included (19 of 22 Act 1 pack cards level, among them the six C1 new-atom cards, Double Tap, Flame Barrier and Berserk, measurement/act1-cards@zero-shot); a card whose value sits in a number left in the leaf state is not covered: Disarm (enemy Strength -2), Impervious (30 block) and Intimidate cost 0.06-0.12 wins, cause open (lane/leaf-blind-numbers); goal-1 card reads play @tsl1 with the plain leaf beside it on turn-start parents (decision/turn-start-leaf-reads); what is left to measure on cards is how the net prices a power's later ticks and content built from atoms it cannot read (how/burst-inputs). Under @tsl1 the burst8 nets are level with the 10-29 net on Demon Form decks (+0.48 (0.81) HP, three seeds) and keep their -0.7 to -1.0 HP cost elsewhere (measurement/burst8-tsl1@cells): what games taught on this row was the first tick. Exit: a turn-start hook needing chance (a draw, a random target) costing more than 0.1 wins with @tsl1 on. A from-scratch learn goes past the first tick: the all-content twins (40k games, one round, Demon Form in the pool) @tsl1 beat the 10-29 net @tsl1 on Demon Form decks by +3.30 (0.95) HP with other held-out decks level (-0.04 (0.60)), where bursts of up to 1.6k games on a trained net, at any exposure share read, learned the first tick only (measurement/pack-net-twin@one-turn).
